resources.string: The Word travels hand to hand.

Sower respects your privacy completely. It collects no personal information, requests no permissions, and makes no network connections, so it cannot send your data anywhere. Everything you read and search stays only on your device. Nothing is tracked, stored on a server, or shared with anyone.\n\nFreely you received; freely give.

This app carries the complete Bible — no internet, no account, no app store. It travels straight from your phone to a friend’s, like a seed passed hand to hand.
On your friend’s phone: open the Bluetooth settings screen and stay there. (That turns Bluetooth on and makes their phone visible — it works on every Android phone.)
On this phone: tap Send this app below, choose Bluetooth, then tap your friend’s phone name when it appears.
Your friend taps Accept, opens the finished file, and allows the install when their phone asks — that question is normal for an app shared phone-to-phone. Done! Their copy can now be passed on too.

Both phones have Quick Share? It’s faster: your friend swipes down from the top of their screen, presses and holds the Quick Share button, and allows “Everyone” — then in step 2 pick Quick Share instead of Bluetooth. Some phones name sharing differently (Huawei Share, Mi Share), but Bluetooth works on them all.
